name: SQLite Improved
description: Replaces the stock system SQLite library with SQLite 3.44.4. Supports 32-bit XP3800 firmware 11.17.00 and 11.20.00. Root and Magisk are required. This affects all apps that use the system SQLite library; keep a verified boot backup before installing.
author: thooton
